title: Reviewer lens files still describe main.rs as a single-file architecture after the include! migration

After the migration (master ebc30de9 and later), main.rs is mostly module declarations, so the lines are stale, though harmless as ignore-rules. These are reviewer guidance, not authority-granting text. Markdown only.
acceptance: The two reviewer lens lines describe the current module layout (or are removed if no longer needed), and the App.tsx line that followed the first one states its own reason; no other change to those files.
The independent review pair has no outstanding in-scope finding of Medium or higher, and the doc link check passes on the exact landed input.
